## `/fundadmin:fund mfn-tracker <files>` {#mfn-tracker}

MFN election tracking across side letters

Tracks MFN provisions across a fund's executed side letters, builds an eligibility matrix per LP, flags cascade risk, and drafts election forms and a redacted disclosure schedule. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund mfn-tracker` or shares several side letters.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund mfn-tracker <files>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-mfn-tracker <files>` |
| Codex | `$fund-mfn-tracker <files>` |

**Writes** `MFN-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-mfn-tracker/SKILL.md)

Uses the host's approved file access and the packaged helpers where required.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)

## `/fundadmin:fund obligation-tracker <files>` {#obligation-tracker}

Obligation inventory, evidence status & deadlines

Inventories every side letter obligation by category, frequency and due date, records the evidence supplied for each and flags what is outstanding. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund obligation-tracker`, asks which deadlines are outstanding, or shares side letters.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund obligation-tracker <files>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-obligation-tracker <files>` |
| Codex | `$fund-obligation-tracker <files>` |

**Writes** `OBLIGATION-TRACKER-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-obligation-tracker/SKILL.md)

**Dependencies and fallbacks**

- **openpyxl** — the .xlsx of the report's tables. If unavailable: CSV of the same tables.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)

## `/fundadmin:fund covenant-monitor <file>` {#covenant-monitor}

Covenant inventory, headroom recompute & threshold flags

Extracts financial, reporting and negative covenants from a credit facility and recomputes headroom from supplied data; no compliance verdict. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund covenant-monitor`, asks about covenant breach risk, or shares a subscription line or loan agreement.

## `/fundadmin:fund regulatory-calendar <details>` {#regulatory-calendar}

Regulatory filing calendar generation

Builds a 12-month filing calendar from fund type, registration and AUM, spanning Form ADV/PF/D, 13F/13H, FATCA/CRS, AIFMD and UK SDR, with an event queue, watch list and 90/60/30-day alerts. Use when the user runs `/fundadmin:fund regulatory-calendar` or asks what filings are due.

| Host | Invocation |
|---|---|
| Claude Code / Cowork | `/fundadmin:fund regulatory-calendar <details>` |
| Claude Code / Cowork, direct | `/fundadmin:fund-regulatory-calendar <details>` |
| Codex | `$fund-regulatory-calendar <details>` |

**Writes** `REGULATORY-CALENDAR-[fund]-[date].md` · [Skill source](https://github.com/davendra/fundadmin-ai-skills/blob/main/plugins/fundadmin/skills/fund-regulatory-calendar/SKILL.md)

**Dependencies and fallbacks**

- **current official authority evidence via host retrieval or supplied sources** — current jurisdiction-specific claims. If unavailable: unverified requirements remain UNKNOWN; no certification.

Saved outputs require the report helper and an approved output folder. Otherwise, the result is an UNVERIFIED chat draft. [Output contract](/guide/outputs) · [Host support](/guide/release)
